recognize_zh: 血液與骨髓中的中型細胞核圓、染色質細緻、細胞質少而深藍，看起來像淋巴芽細胞；但流式顯示 CD34 陰性、CD10 與 CD20 陽性且 kappa 限制，MYC 陽性、Ki-67 近 100%，表示是 blastoid 型雙打擊 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Medium-sized mononuclear cells with round nuclei, fine chromatin, and scant basophilic cytoplasm in blood (panels A-B)
Bone marrow aspirate dominated by monotonous blastoid cells with deeply basophilic cytoplasm (panel C)
Biopsy with diffuse sheets of intermediate-sized cells replacing marrow (panel D)
IHC: diffuse nuclear PAX5 (E), cytoplasmic staining in panel F (BCL2 among the markers listed), nuclear MYC in many cells (G), and Ki-67 approaching 100% (H)
Flow cytometry: CD45-dim cells in the blast region, CD34 negative, cyCD79a positive, CD19 positive, CD3 negative, CD10 positive, and kappa restricted (panels I-M)
describe_en: Peripheral blood shows occasional medium-sized cells with round nuclei, fine chromatin, and scant basophilic cytoplasm, and the bone marrow aspirate is largely replaced by similar blastoid cells. The biopsy shows diffuse sheets of intermediate-sized cells that are PAX5 positive with strong MYC expression and a Ki-67 index approaching 100%. Flow cytometry demonstrates a CD34-negative, CD19+, CD10+, cytoplasmic CD79a+ B-cell population with kappa light chain restriction. The presence of surface light chain restriction and absence of CD34/TdT argue against lymphoblastic leukemia; with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements by FISH, findings are consistent with DLBCL/HGBL with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements, blastoid morphology.

ddx.vs: B-ALL blasts are usually CD34 and/or TdT positive and lack surface immunoglobulin light chain restriction, unlike this kappa-restricted TdT-negative population.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with lipid vacuoles, are BCL2 negative, and carry MYC rearrangement without BCL2 rearrangement.
Blastoid MCL is CD5 positive, CD10 negative, and cyclin D1/SOX11 positive, while this case is CD10+ and cyclin D1 negative.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: AML blasts lack PAX5, CD19, and light chain expression and typically express CD34/CD117/CD13/CD33.

stain: Wright-Giemsa; H&E; IHC: PAX5, BCL2, MYC, Ki-67; flow
